name: data-analyst-agent
headline: Dataa Analyst Agent - AI Document Analysis Tool
short_description: Dataa Analyst Agent is an AI-powered Streamlit app designed for document analysis and interaction. It uses LLMs and Together AI to analyze, summarize, and chat with various document formats including PDFs, DOCX, and images.
author: DevanshSrajput

sections.overview:
AI Document Analyst is a Streamlit-based application that processes multiple document formats including PDFs, Word documents, images, CSV, and Excel files. It uses OpenCode Zen (OpenAI-compatible chat completions) to summarize content, answer questions about documents, and extract insights through conversational AI. The tool features real-time file processing, auto-generated visualizations, statistical analysis, and dark/light theme support. Built for professionals who need to quickly extract information from documents without manual review.
Summarizing lengthy reports
Extracting data from CSV files
Chatting with PDF documents for insights
Visualizing data trends from documents
sections.usage:
```
Analyze the following [DOCUMENT] from [COMPANY] in the [INDUSTRY] sector. Provide a summary of key findings, insights, and recommendations. Focus on [SPECIFIC_TOPIC] and highlight any trends or patterns.
```
